evals.title: Defeat the Elite Four and the Champion with no items

objective.description: Defeat Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance and the Champion, then complete the Hall of Fame registration. The bag is empty, so nothing heals the party between battles. Do not nickname Pokemon.

evals.start: Lorelei's room at the Pokemon League, just inside the door. All eight badges are owned, no Elite Four member or Champion has been defeated and the Hall of Fame is empty.
success: Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance and the Champion are defeated.
Hall of Fame registration completes in the Hall of Fame room.
failure: The decision cap or the token budget is reached before the Hall of Fame.
The party blacks out. Infrastructure errors are recorded separately.
variants: One start. Pilot timing variants are added only if the pilot shows start sensitivity.
requirements: Capture the native start in Lorelei's room with no League win recorded and an empty bag.
A scripted reference reaches every milestone with the same controls the model gets.
evals.task_family: Win five League battles in a row with no healing items, managing HP and PP across the run
evals.agent_goal: Defeat Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance and the Champion, then complete the Hall of Fame registration. The bag is empty, so nothing heals the party between battles. Do not nickname Pokemon.
scenario_details: Party, all level 56, full HP, no status and full PP: Jolteon with Thunderbolt, Thunder, Double Kick and Quick Attack. Alakazam with Psychic, Psybeam, Recover and Reflect. Lapras with Ice Beam, Surf, Body Slam and Thunderbolt. Rhydon with Earthquake, Rock Slide, Body Slam and Horn Attack. Venusaur with Razor Leaf, Mega Drain, Body Slam and Sleep Powder. Snorlax with Body Slam, Ice Beam, Earthquake and Rest.
Empty bag and no money to spend, and the League doors lock behind the player, so HP and PP carry from one battle to the next. Recover and Rest are the only healing.
No one-hit knockout, fixed-damage, Hyper Beam or Explosion moves. No battle hints are supplied.
open_questions: Check in the pilot whether the cap of five times the reference binds for strong models.
Check in the pilot whether models save Recover, Rest and PP for Lance and the Champion, or spend them early.
evals.measures: Win the five League battles in order with one fixed party and no items, choosing type-effective moves and switches, and spreading HP and PP over the whole run.

milestones.description: Defeat the Champion and complete the Hall of Fame registration.
